04.name: decode_postfix

prompt.zh: 实现完整解码器 decode_postfix(tokens, catalog)：解析后缀表达式，生成切片树，自下而上算尺寸、自上而下算坐标；返回树、尺寸、坐标与可读错误。已提供 combine 与 Lab2 的 validate_layout 作辅助。约定：H 的第一区域在下、第二区域在上；V 的第一区域在左、第二区域在右；先弹出的是第二区域。错误码：underflow:X、leftover:N、unknown:X、duplicate:X、missing:清单。
prompt.en: Implement the full decoder decode_postfix(tokens, catalog): parse the postfix expression, build the slicing tree, aggregate sizes bottom-up and propagate coordinates top-down. Helpers combine and the Lab2 validate_layout are provided. Convention: H places the first region below the second; V places the first left of the second; the first pop is the second region. Error codes: underflow:X, leftover:N, unknown:X, duplicate:X, missing:list.

tests: standard coordinates match the taught layout
rows are complete, sorted and checkable

(lambda r: r['tree']['op']=='V' and r['tree']['right']['id']=='E' and r['tree']['left']['right']['id']=='C' and r['tree']['left']['left']['op']=='V' and r['tree']['left']['left']['left']['op']=='H' and r['tree']['left']['left']['left']['size']==(3,3))(decode_postfix(['A','D','H','B','V','C','V','E','V'],{"A":[3,2],"B":[2,3],"C":[2,2],"D":[3,1],"E":[2,2]}))

first H changed to V overflows to width 12
underflow keeps partial events but no result

(lambda r: r['ok'] is True and r['coords']['Q']==(1.5,0,1,2) and r['size']==(2.5,2))(decode_postfix(['P','Q','V'],{'P':(1.5,2),'Q':(1,2)}))

B below A stacks heights in the other order
V children add widths in order
H children take the max width
combined rows always pass Lab2 when inside outline
structure and geometry are separate questions
empty token list is an error, not a layout
every coordinate clears its region bounds

05.name: pack_bstar

prompt.zh: 实现完整打包器 pack_bstar(tree, modules)：先序遍历树，左孩子从父块右边缘开始、右孩子与父块同 x；每个模块落到整个覆盖区间 [x,x+w) 下最高的轮廓线上。放块后拆分旧区间、保留两侧残段、合并相邻等高段。返回 order/coords/rows/contour/trace。错误码：unknown:X、duplicate:X、missing:清单。tree 是 (id, left, right) 嵌套元组，叶子可写 (id,None,None) 或直接写 id 字符串。
prompt.en: Implement the full packer pack_bstar(tree, modules): preorder walk, left child at the parent right edge, right child at the parent x; each block lands on the highest skyline under its whole footprint [x,x+w). Split old segments, keep residuals, merge equal neighbours. Return order/coords/rows/contour/trace. Error codes: unknown:X, duplicate:X, missing:list. tree is nested (id,left,right) tuples; leaves may be (id,None,None) or the bare id string.

right child is not always on the parent top

06.name: decode_sequence_pair

07.name: anneal

prompt.zh: 实现通用退火状态机 anneal(initial, neighbor, decode, score, feasible, rng, schedule, budget)：当前/候选/最好合法解分开保存；ΔE≤0 直接接受，ΔE>0 以 exp(−ΔE/T) 与 u 比较；拒绝不改当前；最好合法解只减不增；日志记录每步 T、候选能量、ΔE、u、接受、当前能量、最好能量；恰好评估 budget 次。已提供 Lab6 解码器、能量/可行/邻居/随机数/温度计划的构造器——状态机是你来实现的部分。
prompt.en: Implement the generic annealing state machine anneal(initial, neighbor, decode, score, feasible, rng, schedule, budget): current/candidate/best-legal are stored separately; accept downhill always and uphill when u < exp(-delta/T); a rejected candidate must not touch current; the best legal solution only improves; the log records T, candidate energy, delta, u, acceptance, current and best energy per step; exactly budget evaluations. The Lab6 decoder and score/feasible/neighbor/rng/schedule builders are provided - the state machine is yours.

tests: deterministic: same seed replays the same log
log has one complete entry per step

(lambda r: len(r['log'])==6 and all(set(e)>= {'step','T','candidate_energy','delta','u','accepted','current_energy','best_energy'} for e in r['log']))(anneal(('ABCED','DABCE'),make_neighbor(constant_rng([0.3,0.6,0.9,0.1]*50)),make_decoder({"A":[3,2],"B":[2,3],"C":[2,2],"D":[3,1],"E":[2,2]}),make_score((10,8)),make_feasible((10,8),{"A":[3,2],"B":[2,3],"C":[2,2],"D":[3,1],"E":[2,2]}),constant_rng([0.3,0.6,0.9,0.1]*50),cooling(12,0.97),6))
